title: PINNForge: Execution-Grounded Evolutionary Design of Physics-Informed Neural Networks for PDE Solving via Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.23023v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) require coordinated choices over network representation, sampling, loss construction, and optimization, while effective configurations often vary substantially across partial differential equations (PDEs). Existing automated PINN design methods can search candidate configurations, but information revealed during actual training is still used mainly for evaluation rather than to improve subsequent design, leading to repeated trial-and-error and inefficient use of training budget. We propose PINNsForge, an LLM-driven evolutionary framework for execution-feedback-based automated PINN design. PINNsForge generates diverse candidate configurations from PDE-related prior knowledge, evaluates them through actual training, and feeds high-performing designs together with accumulated execution evidence back to the LLM. translated_title: PINNForge：基于执行反馈的大语言模型驱动进化设计物理信息神经网络求解偏微分方程
translated_abstract: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）需要在网络表示、采样、损失构建和优化等方面进行协调选择，而有效的配置在不同的偏微分方程（PDE）之间往往存在显著差异。现有的自动化PINN设计方法虽然可以搜索候选配置，但实际训练过程中揭示的信息主要用于评估，而非用于改进后续设计，导致反复试错和训练预算的低效使用。我们提出了PINNsForge，一个由大语言模型驱动的、基于执行反馈的自动化PINN设计进化框架。PINNsForge从PDE相关的先验知识出发生成多样化的候选配置，通过实际训练对其进行评估，并将高性能设计连同积累的执行证据反馈给大语言模型。在观察到的优化行为引导下，大语言模型随后对设计进行改进、重组和探索（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: PINNForge提出了一种由大语言模型驱动的进化框架，将实际训练产生的执行反馈（而非仅用于评估）循环回LLM以指导后续设计，从而为不同偏微分方程更高效地自动搜索有效的PINN配置。
en_tdlr: PINNForge is an LLM-driven evolutionary framework that feeds execution evidence from actual training back to the LLM to guide subsequent design, enabling efficient automated search of effective PINN configurations for solving diverse PDEs.
